newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sells Canadian dollars - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sells Canadian dollars - traders.

text.p: The Bank of Canada intervened and sold Canadian dollars for U.S. dollars as the currency traded around the C$1.3440/45 level, dealers said.
The intervention was through brokers and considered light as the currency strengthened through key resistance.
Following the intervention, the Canadian dollar was trading at C$1.3441 after opening at C$1.3451 and closing Tuesday of C$1.3519. Traders expected further gains.
Dealers said rose on buying interests resulting from a bullish article in Britain's Financial Times newspaper.
The Bank of Canada does not comment on intervention.
